## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; confirmation: Energy and Financials show pockets of strength (XOM (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +9.40%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +16.89%) ABOVE TREND) while large-cap tech and healthcare megacaps are broadly BELOW TREND (AAPL (1W: -0.53% | 1M: -4.95%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -4.24% | 1M: -3.58%) BELOW TREND). Major divergence across timeframes (multiple banks and tech names with 1W bounces vs 1M weakness) reinforces a transitional market tone.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +9.40%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +16.89%) ABOVE TREND. Financials show opportunistic strength: MS (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -6.32%) RECOVERY, GS (1W: +4.59% | 1M: -9.39%) RECOVERY, JPM (1W: +1.31% | 1M: -6.72%) RECOVERY. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Healthcare weak: UNH (1W: -5.59% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -9.80%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples & Real Estate under pressure: KHC (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -11.61%) BELOW TREND, UL (1W: -6.66% | 1M: -15.97%) BELOW TREND, VTR (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -4.76%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: SLB (1W: +9.54% | 1M: -3.15%) RECOVERY, LRCX (1W: +6.34% | 1M: -4.63%) RECOVERY, MS (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -6.32%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +16.89%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +18.93%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Concentrated (Energy/Technology skew: 4/5 in Energy+Tech).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -10.67% | 1M: -30.37%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -10.94% | 1M: -19.48%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -9.80%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -7.46% | 1M: -8.84%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.05% | 1M: -14.49%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in defensives, materials and select industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W: SLB (1W: +9.54% | 1M: -3.15%) RECOVERY, LRCX (1W: +6.34% | 1M: -4.63%) RECOVERY, MS (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -6.32%) RECOVERY; note major divergence where several large names show 1W bounces against 1M declines — tactical momentum, not confirmed breadth.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is mixed-to-weak with megacap pressure: AAPL (1W: -0.53% | 1M: -4.95%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -4.24% | 1M: -3.58%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -7.47%) BELOW TREND, while PLTR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +18.93%) ABOVE TREND and LRCX (1W: +6.34% | 1M: -4.63%) RECOVERY show idiosyncratic strength; sector breadth weak (overall tech under pressure).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials showing tactical strength but not broad confirmation: MS (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -6.32%) RECOVERY, GS (1W: +4.59% | 1M: -9.39%) RECOVERY, JPM (1W: +1.31% | 1M: -6.72%) RECOVERY versus V (1W: -1.83% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND; watch for follow-through before treating as sustained leadership.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare weak and leadership lacking: UNH (1W: -5.59% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -2.40%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND is a lone bright spot; sector breadth negative.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective Value/Cyclicals: energy names (XOM (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +9.40%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +16.89%) ABOVE TREND) and tactically favor banks showing 1W strength (MS (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -6.32%) RECOVERY, GS (1W: +4.59% | 1M: -9.39%) RECOVERY); reduce exposure to broad mega-cap techs and defensive staples that are BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: OXY (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +16.89%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +18.93%) ABOVE TREND — watch for continuation. BEARISH: LLY (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -9.80%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -10.67% | 1M: -30.37%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.05% | 1M: -14.49%) BELOW TREND — downside risk remains.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +11.57%) showing clear leadership among sectors; Financials (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -6.96%) for tactical rotation. BEARISH: Healthcare (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -6.83%) and Consumer Staples (1W: -4.80% | 1M: -9.06%) remain at risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -7.47%) BELOW TREND — failure to stabilize would signal further tech weakness; monitor AAPL (1W: -0.53% | 1M: -4.95%) BELOW TREND for reclaim of monthly zone; XOM (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +9.40%) ABOVE TREND continuation needed to confirm energy-led risk appetite; JPM (1W: +1.31% | 1M: -6.72%) RECOVERY needs follow-through to validate financial leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
PLTR (+65): PLTR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +18.93%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment (Pentagon program) confirmed by price. BA (+80): BA (1W: -7.05% | 1M: -14.49%) BELOW TREND — bullish headline but price is diverging (distribution), monitor closely.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
UNH (-60): UNH (1W: -5.59% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND — bearish news confirming weakness. PFE (-55): PFE (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND — negative study result but price is holding, a divergence to watch. MSFT (-45): MSFT (1W: -4.24% | 1M: -3.58%) BELOW TREND — negative sentiment aligns with price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Value/Cyclical tilt. XOM (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +9.40%) ABOVE TREND and CVX (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while AAPL (1W: -0.53% | 1M: -4.95%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -4.24% | 1M: -3.58%) BELOW TREND show large-cap tech weakness. Key risk: major divergence between 1W bounces in banks/energy and broad 1M weakness in megacaps—monitor sentiment-driven catalysts (PLTR confirmed, BA headline diverging) for confirmation before increasing exposure.
